decision_points.condition: UE was previously registered in S1 mode before entering EMM-DEREGISTERED, and has received an "interworking without N26 interface not supported" indication, and EPS security context and a valid native 4G-GUTI are available: UE includes a 5G-GUTI mapped from the valid native 4G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE, and includes UE status IE with EMM registration status set to "UE is not in EMM-REGISTERED state" and includes an ATTACH REQUEST message in the EPS NAS message container IE.
UE is registering with a PLMN and holds a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the same PLMN: UE indicates the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE.

UE is registering with a SNPN, holds a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the same SNPN, and is not initiating initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN: UE indicates the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE.
UE is registering with a PLMN and holds a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by an equivalent PLMN: UE indicates the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE.

UE is registering with a SNPN, holds a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by an equivalent SNPN identified by a globally unique SNPN identity, and is not initiating initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN: UE indicates the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE and includes the NID of the equivalent SNPN in the NID IE.
UE is registering with a PLMN and holds a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by any other PLMN: UE indicates the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE.

UE is registering with an SNPN, holds a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by any other SNPN identified by a globally unique SNPN identity, and is not initiating initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN: UE indicates the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE and includes the NID of the other SNPN in the NID IE.
SUCI other than onboarding SUCI is available, and the UE is not initiating initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN: UE includes the SUCI in the 5GS mobile identity IE.
UE does not hold a valid 5G-GUTI or SUCI other than onboarding SUCI, and is initiating initial registration for emergency services: PEI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE.
UE is initiating initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN: Onboarding SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE.
SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE and timer T3519 is not running: UE starts timer T3519 and stores the value of SUCI.
UE is operating in dual-registration mode and it is in EMM state EMM-REGISTERED: UE includes the UE status IE with the EMM registration status set to "UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state".
Last visited registered TAI is available: UE includes the last visited registered TAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE requests the use of SMS over NAS: UE includes the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the SMS requested bit set to "SMS over NAS supported".
UE supports MICO mode and requests the use of MICO mode: UE includes the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE requests to use an active time value: UE includes the active time value in the T3324 IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE needs to use the UE specific DRX parameters: UE includes the Requested DRX parameters IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE is in NB-N1 mode and needs to use the UE specific DRX parameters for NB-N1 mode: UE includes the Requested NB-N1 mode DRX parameters IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports eDRX and requests the use of eDRX: UE includes the Requested extended DRX parameters IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE needs to request LADN information: UE includes the LADN indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE has allowed NSSAI or configured NSSAI or both for the current PLMN or SNPN: UE includes the requested NSSAI containing the S-NSSAI(s) corresponding to the slice(s) to which the UE intends to register with and includes the mapped S-NSSAI(s) for the requested NSSAI, if available, in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

Both the S-NSSAI to be replaced and the alternative S-NSSAI are included in the configured NSSAI, and the UE needs to request the S-NSSAI to be replaced: UE includes the S-NSSAI to be replaced in the requested NSSAI.

UE supports the S-NSSAI time validity information, and S-NSSAI time validity information is available for an S-NSSAI, and the S-NSSAI time validity information indicates that the S-NSSAI is not available: UE shall not include the S-NSSAI in the Requested NSSAI IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE has neither allowed NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN nor configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN and has a default configured NSSAI: UE includes the S-NSSAI(s) in the Requested NSSAI IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message using the default configured NSSAI and includes the Network slicing indication IE with the Default configured NSSAI indication bit set to "Requested NSSAI created from default configured NSSAI".

UE has no allowed NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, no configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, and no default configured NSSAI: UE shall not include a requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
All the S-NSSAI(s) corresponding to the slice(s) to which the UE intends to register are included in the pending NSSAI: UE shall not include a requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE initiates an initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN: UE shall not include the Requested NSSAI IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports NSAG: UE sets the NSAG bit to "NSAG supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for acknowledging the reception of NSAG information IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message: UE sets the RCMAN bit to "Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for NSAG information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE initiates an initial registration for emergency services or needs to prolong the established NAS signalling connection after the completion of the initial registration procedure: UE sets the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending".
UE supports S1 mode, has not disabled its E-UTRA capability, and the 5GS registration type IE is not set to "disaster roaming initial registration": UE includes S1 mode related IEs.
UE supports the LTE positioning protocol (LPP) in N1 mode: UE sets the LPP bit to "LPP in N1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports the Location Services (LCS) notification mechanisms in N1 mode: UE sets the 5G-LCS bit to "LCS notification mechanisms supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports the user plane positioning using LCS-UPP: UE sets the LCS-UPP bit to "LCS-UPP user plane positioning supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports the user plane positioning using SUPL: UE sets the SUPL bit to "SUPL user plane positioning supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports network verified UE location over satellite NG-RAN: UE sets the NVL-SATNR bit to "Network verified UE location over satellite NG-RAN supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE is in NB-N1 mode: UE sets the Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization bit to "Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE is capable of NB-S1 mode: UE sets the Control plane CIoT EPS optimization bit to "Control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" in the S1 UE network capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports N3 data transfer and multiple user-plane resources in NB-N1 mode: UE sets the Multiple user-plane resources support bit to "Multiple user-plane resources supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports 5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to UTRAN: UE sets the 5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to UTRAN capability bit to "5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to UTRAN supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and includes the Mobile station classmark 2 IE and the Supported codecs IE.
UE supports service gap control: UE sets the SGC bit to "service gap control supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports the restriction on use of enhanced coverage: UE sets the RestrictEC bit to "Restriction on use of enhanced coverage supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports network slice-specific authentication and authorization: UE sets the NSSAA bit to "network slice-specific authentication and authorization supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports CAG feature: UE sets the CAG bit to "CAG Supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports extended CAG information list: UE sets the Ex-CAG bit to "Extended CAG information list supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports enhanced CAG information: UE sets the ECI bit to "enhanced CAG information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports network slice replacement: UE sets the NSR bit to "network slice replacement supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for acknowledging the reception of Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message: UE sets the RCMP bit to "Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for negotiated PEIPS assistance information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

When the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, if the UE supports RACS: UE sets the RACS bit to "RACS supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message; if the UE has an applicable network-assigned UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN or SNPN, includes the applicable network-assigned UE radio capability ID in the UE radio capability ID IE; if does not have an applicable network-assigned UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN or SNPN; and has an applicable manufacturer-assigned UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration,includes the applicable manufacturer-assigned UE radio capability ID in the UE radio capability ID IE.
UE has one or more stored UE policy sections: UE sets the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container" and includes the UE STATE INDICATION message in the Payload container IE.

UE does not have any stored UE policy section and needs to send a UE policy container to the network: UE sets the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container" and includes the UE STATE INDICATION message in the Payload container IE.
UE does not have a valid 5G NAS security context: UE sends the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE.
UE has a valid 5G NAS security context and the UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs: UE sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message including the NAS message container IE.

UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and needs to obtain new ciphering keys: UE includes the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set to "ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested".
UE supports WUS assistance information: UE sets the WUSA bit to "WUS assistance information reception supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports PEIPS assistance information: UE sets the NR-PSSI bit to "NR paging subgrouping supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports V2X: UE sets the V2X bit to "V2X supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5: UE sets the V2XCEPC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports V2X communication over NR-PC5: UE sets the V2XCNPC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports ER-NSSAI: UE sets the ER-NSSAI bit to "Extended rejected NSSAI supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports the NSSRG: UE sets the NSSRG bit to "NSSRG supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
W-AGF acting on behalf of an N5GC device initiates an initial registration: W-AGF includes the N5GC indication IE with the N5GC device indication bit set to "N5GC device registration is requested".
5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device initiates an initial registration: 5G-RG includes the AUN3 indication IE with the AUN3 device indication bit set to "AUN3 device registration is requested".
UE supports UAS services: UE sets the UAS bit to "UAS services supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports A2X over E-UTRA-PC5: UE sets the A2XEPC5 bit to "A2X over E-UTRA-PC5 supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports A2X over NR-PC5: UE sets the A2XNPC5 bit to "A2X over NR-PC5 supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.
UE supports A2X over Uu: UE sets the A2X-Uu bit to "A2X over Uu supported" in the 5GMM capability IE.

UE supporting UAS services initiates an initial registration for UAS services: UE includes the service-level device ID in the Service-level-AA container IE and sets the value to the CAA-level UAV ID and UE includes the service-level-AA server address in the Service-level-AA container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and sets the value to the USS address, if it is provided by the upper layers and UE includes the service-level-AA payload in the Service-level-AA container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and shall set the service-level-AA payload type, if the service-level-AA payload is provided by upper layers.
UE supports 5G ProSe direct discovery: UE sets the 5G ProSe-dd bit to "5G ProSe direct discovery supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports 5G ProSe direct communication: UE sets the 5G ProSe-dc bit to "5G ProSe direct communication supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l2relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l3relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network remote UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l2rmt bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network remote UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network remote UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l3rmt bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network remote UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-UE relay UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l2U2U relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-UE relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l3U2U relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-2 end UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l2end bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 end UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE: UE sets the 5G ProSe-l3end bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

MUSIM UE supports the N1 NAS signalling connection release: UE sets the N1 NAS signalling connection release bit to "N1 NAS signalling connection release supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

MUSIM UE supports the paging indication for voice services: UE sets the paging indication for voice services bit to "paging indication for voice services supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
MUSIM UE supports the reject paging request: UE sets the reject paging request bit to "reject paging request supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

MUSIM UE sets the reject paging request bit to "reject paging request supported", the N1 NAS signalling connection release bit to "N1 NAS signalling connection release supported", or both of them, and supports the paging restriction: UE sets the paging restriction bit to "paging restriction supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports MINT: UE sets the MINT bit to "MINT supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports slice-based N3IWF selection: UE sets the SBNS bit to "Slice-based N3IWF selection supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports slice-based TNGF selection: UE sets the SBTS bit to "Slice-based TNGF selection supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services, the UE has determined the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition and: a) the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition is the HPLMN and: 1) the Additional GUTI IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and does not contain a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the HPLMN; or 2) the Additional GUTI IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the 5GS mobile identity IE contains neither the SUCI nor a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the HPLMN; or b) the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition is not the HPLMN and: 1) the Additional GUTI IE is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and does not contain a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition; or 2) the Additional GUTI IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the 5GS mobile identity IE does not contain a valid 5G-GUTI that was previously assigned by the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition; : UE includes in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition.
UE supports event notification: UE sets the EventNotification bit to "Event notification supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports access to an SNPN using credentials from a credentials holder and: a) the UE is in its HPLMN or EHPLMN or the subscribed SNPN; or b) the UE is in a non-subscribed SNPN and supports equivalent SNPNs: UE sets the SSNPNSI bit to "SOR-SNPN-SI supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports equivalent SNPNs: UE sets the ESI bit to "equivalent SNPNs supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports the unavailability period: UE sets the UN-PER bit to "unavailability period supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change: UE sets the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports LADN per DNN and S-NSSAI: UE sets the LADN-DS bit to "LADN per DNN and S-NSSAI supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports MPS indicator update via the UE configuration update procedure: UE sets the MPSIU bit to "MPS indicator update supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports MCS indicator update via the UE configuration update procedure: UE sets the MCSIU bit to "MCS indicator update supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

UE supports ranging and sidelink positioning as specified in 3GPP TS 24.514 [62] and supports: a) V2X communication over PC5 as specified in 3GPP TS 24.587 [19B]; b) 5G ProSe direct discovery and 5G ProSe direct communication as specified in 3GPP TS 24.554 [19E]; or c) both a) and b): UE sets: a) the RSLP bit to "Ranging and sidelink positioning supported" if the UE supports ranging and sidelink positioning as target UE or SL reference UE or both; b) the RSLPL bit to "Ranging and sidelink positioning for located UE supported" if the UE supports ranging and sidelink positioning as located UE; c) the RSLPS bit to "Ranging and sidelink positioning for SL positioning server UE supported" if the UE supports ranging and sidelink positioning as SL positioning server UE; or d) any combination of a), b) and c), in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

If the UE supports ranging and sidelink positioning with V2X capable UE: UE sets the RSLPVU bit to "Ranging and sidelink positioning with V2X capable UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

If the UE supports ranging and sidelink positioning with 5G ProSe capable UE: UE sets the RSLPPU bit to "Ranging and sidelink positioning with 5G ProSe capable UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports the partial network slice: UE sets the PNS bit to "Partial network slice supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports network slice usage control: UE sets the NSUC bit to "Network slice usage control supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports the S-NSSAI time validity information: UE sets the TempNS bit to "S-NSSAI time validity information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports the S-NSSAI location validity information: UE sets the SLVI bit to "S-NSSAI location validity information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE supports RAT utilization control: UE sets the RATUC bit to "RAT utilization control supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message over 3GPP access.

dependencies.depends_on: Previous step where T3502 was running
dependencies.condition: If timer T3502 is currently running

dependencies.depends_on: Previous step where T3511 was running
dependencies.condition: If timer T3511 is currently running
